frontmatter.title: Residues, Principal Values, and Dispersion Relations

children.value: This page was migrated from the CHM 696 course materials developed by Jonathan Hood and Lyudmila Slipchenko. Equations and examples remain under editorial review during the Fall 2026 website migration.
By the end of this lecture, you should be able to:
evaluate real integrals and inverse Laplace transforms with residues;
define and calculate Cauchy principal values;
track the sign of a real-axis pole indentation; and
derive Kramers--Kronig relations from causality and analyticity.
